title: Clojure is Not Afraid of the GPU - Dragan Djuric
summary: Dragan Djuric presents Clojure libraries for GPU and numerical computing, including ClojureCL, ClojureCUDA and Neanderthal. He shows how a dynamic REPL workflow can be combined with low-level hardware acceleration for machine learning and data science.
why: HN commenters point to it as the talk by the author of Neanderthal and the Clojure GPU libraries, including comparisons against the JVM and CPU.

quote.text: Watch his talk from EuroClojure 2016 in Bratislava
